# Jagrit Vats

> Backend engineer at Bajaj Finserv Health, based in Bangalore, India. Leads a team building a new product from scratch on Spring Boot, works on the Kafka integration layer that connects internal services to Salesforce and other external systems, and builds AI and full-stack side projects in TypeScript and Python.

This file summarises https://jagritvats.netlify.app/ for language models and other tools. A structured résumé is at https://jagritvats.netlify.app/resume.json in JSON Resume format.

## Experience

- Bajaj Finserv Health, July 2023 to now. Software Development Engineer since October 2025, Associate Software Development Engineer from July 2024 to October 2025, and Software Development Engineer Intern from July 2023 to June 2024.
  - Leads a team setting up a new product from scratch on Spring Boot: VMs provisioned with Ansible, application architecture and domain entities, and deployment through Azure Pipelines to a multi-node Docker Swarm cluster.
  - Works on the integration layer that connects internal services to Salesforce and other external systems through Kafka events, with retry topics and dead-letter queues so failed events are retried or parked for replay.
  - Builds multi-step asynchronous workflows on Kafka, with Redis and in-memory caching.
  - Cut latency on endpoints that call several downstream APIs by running those calls in parallel on Java virtual threads.
  - Improved tracing across services with Spring Boot advice and custom interceptors that propagate trace IDs, and that also handle payload encryption and a standard response format.
  - Cut service startup time roughly in half through application-initialization changes and Kubernetes liveness and readiness probe tuning. Other services adopted the same approach.
  - Automated release steps with Azure Pipelines and OpenAPI/Swagger contract generation, and contributes to design and architecture reviews for new core modules.
- Angrybaaz Services, frontend development intern, November 2022 to January 2023. Built UI components for a Figma plugin using React, TypeScript and the Figma API.

## Projects

- [TeamTakes](https://teamtakes.app): Opinionated polls and play-money prediction games for engineering teams. Live. Each team gets its own subdomain, and row-level security in Postgres (self-hosted Supabase) limits every query to the user's own teams. A leak test checks that one team can't read or change another team's data. Built with TanStack Start (React 19), Docker Compose, Traefik and Cloudflare.
- [ScenePilot](https://github.com/jagritvats/scenepilot-public): An AI assistant director that reschedules film shoots when plans change, built for Google Cloud's Agentic Cinema hackathon in 2026. Gemini agents built with Google ADK research a disruption using Parallel's web APIs and suggest new schedules. A deterministic rule checker rejects schedules that break a permit window, a noise curfew or the available daylight. Python, FastAPI, Next.js 16, Cloud Run, more than 600 tests. [Live demo](https://scenepilot-web-483371182667.asia-south1.run.app)
- [Synpse](https://web.synpse.app): An AI companion with long-term memory, on the web, Android and Telegram. The Android app has over 500 installs on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.synapy.app). Memories are ranked on six signals, and a background job consolidates them every four hours. Next.js, Express, TypeScript, MongoDB, LangChain, Expo.
- [ResidentOps](https://residentops.synpse.app): An agent that handles maintenance issues for a residents' association, built for AWS's Agents for Humans hackathon. Python, Strands Agents, Amazon Bedrock. [Code on GitHub](https://github.com/jagritvats/residentops-pb)
- [Parley](https://parley.synpse.app): Lets two AI agents from different vendors talk in a shared room. Their claims have to cite evidence, and the meeting minutes are put together from the event log. TypeScript, Hono, MCP, React.
- [SAMAY](https://samay.synpse.app): Helps people in India respond to online fraud and prepares a report to file on cybercrime.gov.in. Built for the Build What Moves India hackathon. Next.js, Postgres.
- Presentic: A command-line tool and MCP server that makes narrated demo videos from a JSON plan, using Playwright and Remotion. Private repository.
